blocks.text: *This Meccan sûrah was revealed to reassure the Prophet (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *). Since the* *Prophet’s sons died in childhood, Al-’Ȃṣ ibn Wâ*' *il, an infamous Meccan* *pagan, used to say that Muḥammad (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *) would be forgotten because he* *had no son to carry his name. Today, ‘Muḥammad’ is the most common* name in the world, whereas the name of Al-’Ȃṣ is barely mentioned.
*The Prophet (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *) is ordered to be devoted to Allah alone, which is the* underlying theme of the next sûrah.
In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness. [1332]
So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺.
Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺.
